name: Afarak Group
operations: Afarak Mogale smelter at Krugersdorp; Stellite chrome mine and Mecklenburg project in Limpopo; Afarak South Africa (Pty) Ltd office at 4th Floor, 267 West Street, Centurion (+27 11 668 3800)
scale_note: Mogale Alloys: two 20 MVA submerged-arc furnaces for SiMn plus DC open-bath furnaces rated 40 MVA and 10 MVA for FeCr

name: Alexkor
operations: Alexkor RMC Pooling and Sharing Joint Venture (Alexkor 51% / Richtersveld Mining Company 49%); contractor-based land, beach and marine diamond mining; corporate unit at 1 Maxwell Drive, Sunninghill, Megawatt Park

name: ASA Metals / Dilokong Chrome
operations: Dilokong chromite mine approx. 30 km from Burgersfort on the R37, plus a ferrochromium plant near Polokwane; mine placed in business rescue on 24 March 2016 and the smelting assets were subsequently acquired by Samancor Chrome
scale_note: Chrome ore capacity 400 000 t/y; two smelters with combined capacity of 120 000 t/y ferrochrome

name: Bauba Resources
operations: Moeijelijk chrome mine approx. 57 km north-west of Burgersfort (Fetakgomo Local Municipality) with wash plant; Kookfontein and Naboom chrome projects; platinum exploration project; corporate office 50 Tegel Avenue, Highveld, Centurion (0871 580 560)

name: Black Mountain Mining
operations: Deeps and Swartberg underground mines and the Gamsberg open pit with dedicated concentrator plants, Khai-Ma municipality, Namakwa District; site address 1 Penge Road, Aggeneys (+27 54 983 9202)
scale_note: Deeps approx. 1 Mt/y ore; Swartberg approx. 0.9 Mt/y ore; combined FY24 approx. 75 kt metal-in-concentrate; Gamsberg Phase I 4 Mt/y ore and 250 kt/y zinc-in-concentrate

name: Black Royalty Minerals
operations: Chilwavhusiku Colliery in the Bronkhorstspruit district and the Koornfontein coal mine at Middelburg; head office 01 Fort Street, Illovo, Johannesburg (+27 11 023 9380); subsidiary of Makole Group
scale_note: Targeted an additional 50 000 t of coal delivered to Eskom by end April 2018 (company press release; figure is dated)

name: Blyvoor Gold
operations: Blyvooruitzicht underground gold mine approx. 70 km south-west of Johannesburg near Carletonville, with the Blyvoor processing plant adjacent to the PS Shaft; Gauta tailings retreatment project; operated under Aurous Resources (blyvoorgold.com now redirects to aurousresources.com)
scale_note: Over two tonnes of gold delivered to Rand Refinery since the 2015 relaunch (company website; no annual tonnage or MWh published on the site)

name: Buffalo Coal
operations: Magdalena bituminous underground mine approx. 22-24 km north of Dundee with on-site wash plant; Aviemore East anthracite underground mine feeding the Coalfields washing facility in Dundee; held through Buffalo Coal Dundee; offices Greytown Road industrial area, Dundee (+27 34 212 1455)
scale_note: Magdalena phase 2 ramp-up target 36 000-43 000 t/month from Q1 2024 (phase 1 target 20 000 t/month); Magdalena coal calorific value 28.5 MJ/kg

name: Chrometco / Black Chrome
operations: Black Chrome underground mine on the Mooihoek farm approx. 100 km south-east of Polokwane, Eastern Limb of the Bushveld Complex, worked by decline shaft; mining right runs to 2033. Chrometco Limited was renamed Sail Mining Group Limited; JSE listing suspended since 18 July 2022 and Black Chrome Mine (Pty) Ltd was placed in business rescue in June 2022
scale_note: Economically minable reserve in excess of 20 000 000 t of chrome ore

name: Copper 360
operations: O'Okiep Copper District operations: modular flotation plants MFP1 and MFP2 producing copper concentrate, an SX/EW plant, and mining rights over more than 12 mines and 60 prospects across 19 000 ha; mine address 1 Main Road, Nababeep; head office Vineyard Business Park, Stellenbosch
scale_note: MFP1 ore throughput 316 800 tpa; MFP2 ore throughput 250 000 tpa; stated near-term target of 5 000 t/y copper

name: Cronimet Mining South Africa
operations: Thaba Cronimet Chrome Mine, a 2 000 ha mining right granted in 2010 with commercial production from 2011, in the Bushveld Complex outside Thabazimbi; operated by CRONIMET Chrome Mining SA (Pty) Ltd. No live website found for the mining entity (cronimet.co.za is CRONIMET RSA, the stainless-scrap trading arm; group site is cronimet.de)
scale_note: 1 MW off-grid solar PV plant producing an estimated 1.8 GWh/y alongside diesel generation, displacing approx. 450 000 litres of diesel a year

name: Northam Platinum - Zondereinde
operations: Deep-level conventional underground mine approx. 30 km south of Thabazimbi on the Merensky and UG2 reefs, with an on-site smelter and metallurgical complex; mining right of 9 257 ha; corporate office Maxwell Office Park, Waterfall City (+27 11 759 6000)
scale_note: 80 MW solar PPA to deliver 220 GWh/y into Zondereinde's mining and smelting operations from December 2025, about 15% of group energy; Zondereinde absorbs about a quarter of total group energy; FY2025 output 330 769 oz 4E refined
